biography: Marc Miller isn't your typical racing prodigy. Born in the heart of Chicago to a family with no motorsport connections, his journey began on the virtual racetracks of online simulators. He spent countless hours mastering the nuances of each circuit, dissecting telemetry data, and honing his reflexes. His breakthrough came during a local sim racing competition, where his clinical precision caught the eye of a talent scout for a small IndyCar team. The jump to real-world racing was a steep learning curve, but Miller's meticulous approach and unwavering focus allowed him to quickly adapt. After a few years in IndyCar, he made the switch to GT racing, and a chance encounter with a Mercedes-AMG executive led to a coveted spot in their junior driver program. Now, at 22, Miller is proving his mettle on the world stage, his sights set on becoming a GT racing champion.
drivingStyle: Miller's driving style is best described as calculated aggression. He doesn't rely on flamboyant overtakes or last-minute heroics. Instead, he meticulously plans each move, exploiting the smallest weaknesses in his opponents' defenses. His cornering style is precise and efficient, focusing on maximizing exit speed and minimizing tire wear. Under pressure, Miller remains remarkably composed, rarely cracking under the weight of expectation. He's a master of race management, patiently waiting for the opportune moment to strike and secure the win.

rivalries.reason: A fiery Italian driver known for her aggressive on-track maneuvers, Rossi and Miller have clashed repeatedly due to their contrasting driving styles, often resulting in spectacular wheel-to-wheel battles.

Tanaka, a seasoned veteran of GT racing, represents the old guard that Miller is trying to usurp. Their rivalry is built on respect, but also a fierce determination to prove their respective generations are the best.

Vargas and Miller rose through the ranks together, often battling for championship titles. Their rivalry is deeply personal, fueled by a shared ambition and a desire to prove who is the superior talent.

careerHighlight: Winning the 24 Hours of Spa in his debut year with Mercedes-AMG, showcasing his exceptional endurance and strategic prowess.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final lap of the Daytona 24 Hours due to a mechanical failure, costing his team a certain victory.
